description: Search the web, extract content, crawl sites, and run deep research from the terminal.

novel_features.name: RAG Corpus Builder
novel_features.description: Fan out search, extract, and crawl calls with automatic URL deduplication to build a JSONL corpus ready for embedding.

novel_features.name: Corpus Coverage Gaps
novel_features.description: Find URLs mentioned in cached search results that have not yet been extracted, sorted by mention frequency.

novel_features.name: Agent Session Replay
novel_features.description: Replay every search and extract call from a named agent session, substituting cached results so no credits are spent.

novel_features.name: QnA Shortcut
novel_features.description: Get a direct answer to a question — equivalent to search with include_answer=advanced and compact output, no extra flags needed.

novel_features.name: RAG Context Builder
novel_features.description: Output a ready-to-paste LLM context string from search results, formatted as numbered passages with source URLs.

novel_features.name: Local Full-Text Search
novel_features.description: Full-text search over locally cached content without API credits using SQLite FTS5.

novel_features.name: Drift Detection
novel_features.description: Compare current search results against a stored baseline to detect which URLs appeared, disappeared, or shifted score.

novel_features.name: Budget Watch
novel_features.description: Monitor credit burn rate against a daily limit with terminal alerts.

novel_features.name: Cost Report
novel_features.description: Credit spend breakdown by endpoint and time window (today, week, month, all).

novel_features.name: Batch Plan
novel_features.description: Pre-flight a query list against the cache, estimate cost, and run net-new queries within budget.

novel_features.name: Freshness Check
novel_features.description: Find cached pages older than a threshold and output a re-fetch list. Supports 7d, 24h, 168h duration formats.

novel_features.name: Crawl Resume
novel_features.description: Resume an interrupted crawl from its last SQLite checkpoint.

novel_features.name: Research Track
novel_features.description: Background-poll a research task and persist result in SQLite across terminal sessions.

novel_features.name: Sources Rank
novel_features.description: Rank domains by average relevance score across all stored searches.
